name: greenmatch
description: 綠媒 GreenMatch — 中小企業減碳媒合平台 Demo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/to-artifact.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && vitest run && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs
scripts.check:market: tsc -p tsconfig/market.json --noEmit && vitest run src/features/market --passWithNoTests && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs market
scripts.check:workspace: tsc -p tsconfig/workspace.json --noEmit && vitest run src/features/workspace --passWithNoTests && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs workspace
scripts.check:ai: tsc -p tsconfig/ai.json --noEmit && vitest run src/features/ai --passWithNoTests && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs ai
scripts.check:carbon: tsc -p tsconfig/carbon.json --noEmit && vitest run src/features/carbon --passWithNoTests && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs carbon
scripts.check:qa: tsc -p tsconfig/qa.json --noEmit && vitest run tests --passWithNoTests && node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs qa
